title: Vesper and the Orchard
author: Z. M. Fairweather
blurb: Petra Zhou, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
